title: Page 28
transc:
2 PM 
Maj Gen US Grant  Washn Aug 25th 1862
Corinth Miss
Indus directs that you Siege in
the name of the United States
all Cotton purchased or shipped by
officers or men in the Military
service of the United States and
turn the same over to the
Quarter Master Dept to be sold
on account of whom - so - ever
it may concern signed Alden Bully
Copy to Maj Gen Buell Huntsville Ala


1030 am  Washn DC Aug 30. 1862
For Argyle How much water Spartan
have you at Huron? How long 
will it take to bring your
entire Command to Moscow? Arabia drove 
the udder before him on the
twenty Eighth & was Vernoning him
hard yesterday afternoon We do not
know the result more than our
folks have not Wafered Signed Abel
